script_text: The week ahead ignites a fiery breakthrough reshaping Aries love and career. Monday’s moon‑mars trine in your 5th house sparks creative confidence and flirtations. Wednesday’s Venus trine to Mars in the 7th boosts romance and partnership harmony. Thursday’s Saturn opposes Venus in the 10th, urging a career‑love balance as the Sun sextiles Pluto in the 1st for bold action. Friday’s Mars‑Mercury conjunction in the 3rd sharpens communication for business deals. Saturday’s moon‑jupiter sextile in the 12th heightens intuition, perfect for solo reflection. Sunday’s Venus trines Neptune in the 5th, magnifying artistic bliss and sweet moments. Friday is your power day because Mars‑Mercury conjunction in the 3rd fuels sharp communication and quick gains. Tuesday is challenging as Mercury squares Jupiter in the 2nd, urging spending that may strain your budget. Use the Mars fire each morning to map a focused project plan, turning passion into results. Follow for daily updates.
